title: Rooted-Tree Expansions of Renormalized Two-Point Functions
exact_target: Prove the rooted-tree iterated-integral form of every perturbative coefficient of the planar two-point function.

status_qualification: The source supplies the first integral examples and checks low orders; it does not give a complete recursive definition for every allowed tree integral in this brief passage. Any all-order proof must fix that source family, including permitted endpoint constants, rather than allow arbitrary integrals that trivialize the assertion. The same conjecture recurs at ID 30001596.
